title: VesperLiveActivity
description: Single source of truth for the Live Activity wire model (TECHNICAL_SPEC.md §7 "Live Activity and Dynamic Island"). definitions.attributes is the static ActivityAttributes payload; definitions.contentState maps 1:1 to the APNs "content-state" object. Field order here is the canonical key order — the codegen (packages/shared/scripts/genLiveActivityTypes.ts) emits Swift and TS in this exact order. Do NOT hand-edit the generated outputs; edit this file and re-run `pnpm gen:live-activity-types`.

blockId.x-swift-comment: Static attribute — the block UUID this activity tracks.
blockId.x-ts-comment: Static attribute — the block UUID this activity tracks.

blockType.x-swift-comment: Module slug, e.g. "fitness". Plain string — NOT coupled to BlockTypeSchema.
blockType.x-ts-comment: Module slug, e.g. "fitness". Plain string — NOT coupled to BlockTypeSchema.

title.x-swift-comment: Block title shown in the expanded view.
title.x-ts-comment: Block title shown in the expanded view.

endTime.x-swift-comment: ISO8601 block end; parsed on-device to render the countdown.
endTime.x-ts-comment: ISO8601 block end; parsed on-device to render the countdown.

minutesRemaining.x-swift-comment: Server hint; the device recomputes from endTime each minute.
minutesRemaining.x-ts-comment: Server hint; the device recomputes from endTime each minute.

nextBlockTitle.x-swift-comment: Nullable — title of the next block, when pre-armed.
nextBlockTitle.x-ts-comment: Nullable — title of the next block, when pre-armed.

nextBlockStart.x-swift-comment: Nullable — ISO8601 start of the next block, when pre-armed.
nextBlockStart.x-ts-comment: Nullable — ISO8601 start of the next block, when pre-armed.
